subject.title: fix(slack): use endsWith instead of includes for _all_ action_id matching

question: Which permanent owner-controlled contract should identify OpenClaw Slack bulk-action rows without reserving arbitrary external action IDs?
rationale: Current production code does not establish the proposed `_all` namespace, so choosing explicit block metadata, exact namespaced IDs, or a global suffix defines a compatibility contract for plugin-supplied Slack blocks.

options.title: Explicit block marker
options.body: Mark bulk rows when produced and consume that marker during confirmation updates, avoiding action-ID namespace collisions.

options.title: Exact namespaced IDs
options.body: Define a closed set of OpenClaw-owned bulk action IDs and share it between the producer and consumer.

options.title: Reserve `_all` globally
options.body: Document and accept every externally supplied action ID ending in `_all` as a removable bulk control.

recommendation.title: Explicit block marker
recommendation.body: Mark bulk rows when produced and consume that marker during confirmation updates, avoiding action-ID namespace collisions.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history most strongly connects this person to the Slack block-action architecture and subsequent interaction-contract maintenance.
